sections.html: Dwarf coolie loach, Pangio cuneovirgata, grows to only 4 cm long; large females rarely reach 5 cm. They are perfect dwarf loaches for miniature aquariums.

Usually the different species of banded Coolie loaches (Pangio kuhlii, P. semicincta, P. myersi, P. shelfordi, P. alternans, P. cuneovirgata, P. malayana) are not distinguished in the trade because they are so variable in color and are often imported mixed. Sorting Coolie loaches is laborious and also stressful for the animals, so everything is simply labelled "kuhlii".

There is an exception: Pangio cuneovirgata was received from Thailand almost "pure of variety" (only a few small P. semicincta in between).

All Coolie loaches are initially somewhat sensitive to infectious diseases and do not tolerate medications well. Provide a boggy environment with dead leaves, alder cones and peat. Then acclimation succeeds well and you can enjoy these amazingly long-lived dwarfs for many years.
